caseNameFull: Henry Ralph v. Harry H. Howarth, Administrator, etc.

opinions.text: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Nebraska. Argued January 13, 1921. Decided January 17, 1921. Per Curiam. Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6,1916, c. 448, *618§ 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1. Mr. Byron G. Burbank for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Otto H. Zacek for defendant in error.
